descriptionChirho: Core active Qal sense of physically building, constructing, or erecting a structure (city, house, altar, wall, tower), encompassing all finite verb forms (perfect, imperfect, imperative, consecutive, cohortative, jussive), infinitives construct and absolute, and prepositional infinitives -- every inflection of the basic transitive meaning. Glosses: eng 'built / will build / build / let us build / to build', spa 'edifico / construyo / edifiquemos', hin 'बनाया / बनाएगा / बनाओ / बनाने को', arb 'بَنَى / يَبْنِي / اِبْنِ / لِيَبْنِيَ / نَبْنِي', kor '지었다 / 세웠다 / 건축했다 / 짓자 / 짓기 위해', swa '-jenga / kujenga / jengeni'.

Substantivized Qal active participle functioning as an agent noun meaning 'builder(s)' or 'the one(s) who build(s)', used as a designation for construction workers or metaphorically for God as builder. Glosses: eng 'builders / the builders / builder of / your builders', spa 'edificadores / constructores / los que edifican', hin 'बनानेवाले / बनानेवालों', arb 'الْبَانُونَ / الْبَانِينَ / بَانُوكِ / بَنَّاؤُو', kor '건축자들 / 건축하는 자들 / 짓는 자', swa 'wajenzi'.

Qal passive participle used adjectivally to describe something as 'built, constructed' -- a stative description of a completed structure rather than the process of building. Glosses: eng 'built / the built / that is built', spa 'edificada / edificadas / el edificado', hin 'बनी हुई / बने थे / बनाई गई', arb 'مَبْنِيَّةٌ / الْمَبْنِيِّ / المَبنيَّة', kor '건축된 / 세워진 / 건설 된', swa 'zilizojengwa / iliyojengwa / uliojengwa'.

Nifal passive/reflexive sense meaning 'to be built, to be constructed, to be established' -- the passive counterpart of the Qal, used of cities and structures being built, and metaphorically of persons or families being built up or established. Glosses: eng 'was built / will be built / to be built / being built / is built / I will be built up', spa 'fue edificada / sera edificada / para ser edificada / se construia', hin 'बनाया गया / बनाई जाएगी / बनते समय', arb 'بُنِيَتْ / تُبْنَى / يُبْنَى / لِيُبْنَى', kor '지어졌다 / 세워지리라 / 건축될 것이다', swa '-jengwa / kujengwa / itajengwa'.
